name: Accra
tagline: West Africa's buzzing capital of history, art and jollof
summary: Accra is Ghana's lively capital and an easy start to West Africa. See the Kwame Nkrumah Memorial, walk old Jamestown and its lighthouse, browse Makola Market and galleries, eat jollof and kelewele, and travel to Cape Coast Castle, a sobering monument to the slave trade.
seasonNote: November to March is dry but dusty with Harmattan; the main rains are April to June.
arrival: Kotoka International Airport is 20 minutes from Osu.
gettingAround: Uber and Bolt are easiest; tro-tros are local minibuses.
cashTip: Prices are shown in US dollars; locally you pay in Ghana cedis (GHS). Mobile money and cards work in bigger places; carry cedis for markets, tro-tros and tips.
foodTip: Jollof rice, waakye, kelewele and red-red.
buyTip: Kente cloth, beads and contemporary art.
coverWiki: Accra Independence Square Black Star Gate
